Business vehicle FAQs

Before making an enquiry.

Which businesses can use Auto Opulence vehicle-care services?

We provide suitable routes for company fleets, dealerships, taxi and private-hire drivers, lease-return customers, garages, bodyshops and professional detailers. Other commercial requirements can be discussed through the enquiry form.

Can several business vehicles use different services?

Yes. Services are matched to vehicle size, current condition and the required presentation standard, so a regularly maintained vehicle does not need to receive the same treatment as a heavily used or paint-damaged vehicle.

Are business vehicle-care prices published?

Individual service pages show confirmed size-based or session prices where applicable. Multi-vehicle, recurring or unusual requirements are reviewed before a quotation is confirmed.

Where is the work completed?

Auto Opulence operates from Unit 7 Consensus House, St Faiths Road, Norwich, Norfolk, NR6 7BW. Trade users can also book the professional indoor detailing bay for their own work.

How do we request repeat or multi-vehicle work?

Send the number and type of vehicles, current condition, required frequency, preferred dates and presentation standard. We aim to respond to enquiries within 24 hours.

Need a tailored arrangement?

Discuss vehicles, frequency and access.

Tell us the vehicle numbers, sizes, condition, required presentation standard, preferred dates and whether the work is one-off or recurring.
